prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset: the GRAYLIGHT-CREST phase of C01-FX-16 Seven Towers graylight, a tiny tactical cartoon fantasy game effect. The reference is the original four-panel row. Preserve the original subject from its third panel: ONE small dark gray stone tower with an amber top emitter, a strong upward fan of straight silver-gray rays and several small levitating stones. The name Seven Towers is a story context, not an instruction to draw seven towers.
Output ONE square 1254 x 1254 PNG RGBA with genuinely transparent exterior and gaps. Not a sprite sheet, no magenta, white card, checkerboard or background scenery. Important correction to the reference: its highest central ray is clipped at the top. Draw that ray COMPLETE with a visible end and at least 100 source pixels of genuinely empty top margin. No ray or stone may touch any canvas edge.
Common composition master for all four phases: a fixed squat cylindrical medieval tower centered near x627, with its amber light source centered (627,735). Tower body and rubble foot occupy roughly x400..855, y735..1130. Round crenellated parapet, chunky charcoal-gray masonry blocks, dark arched doorway on the front, a few simple stone planes and black charcoal outlines. Low irregular rubble fragments at the base, no smooth pedestal, floor shadow or filled ground disk. The tower will stay exactly at these coordinates in the other phases. Ember-like amber lamp/core in a small dark socket at the center of the parapet, a small pale yellow center, no huge glow bloom.
At the crest, SEVEN straight silver-gray ray wedges fan upward from the same amber source. Central vertical ray extends to y110; two long inner rays to around y180..230; two diagonal broad rays to around x235,y290 and x1000,y270; two shorter outer rays toward x245,y560 and x1030,y540. Rays are crisp elongated angular light shards, narrow near the common emitter and broader toward their distant ends, with simple silver-gray faces and restrained slightly darker gray edges. They are not curving smoke, fire flames, tentacles, lightning bolts or opaque searchlight cones filling the entire fan. Leave generous transparent wedges between them. Keep the upper tips complete and inside x160..1095,y100..735.
Five or six small irregular dark gray stones float around the lower fan, each detached, about 45 to 65 source pixels wide, with a black outline and one lighter face. Show different heights around x310,y640; x395,y400; x855,y390; x1010,y620; x895,y815. Base rubble remains physically stationary and distinct from these levitating pieces. No sparks, labels or extra props.
Style: clean chunky outlined hand-painted cartoon fantasy, simple matte flat-color planes, readable after whole-canvas downsampling to a 28-pixel interior. Do not use noisy photographic texture, blur, halo, broad fog, rectangular alpha wash or unrelated glow pad. This is the third pose of a four-frame NONLOOP 12 fps event: short rays, rising fan, graylight crest, residual rays. Output only this crest image and retain ample true transparency around the full silhouette.
